title: How to Use the La Maison Scheduling Page
subtitle: For La Maison cleaners and property inspectors
end_title: Thank you for taking such good care of La Maison.

segments.spoken: There are five tabs across the top: My dates, Tasks, Supplies, Contractors, and Help. Here's what each one does for you.
segments.tts: [warmly] There are five tabs across the top: My dates, Tasks, Supplies, Contractors, and Help. Here's what each one does for you.

segments.spoken: The page says hello by name, and each tab starts with a short welcome and three quick steps.
segments.tts: The page says hello by name, and each tab starts with a short welcome and three quick steps.

segments.spoken: Let's start with My dates. This is where you choose the days you'd like to work at La Maison.
segments.tts: [happy] Let's start with My dates. This is where you choose the days you'd like to work at La Maison.

segments.spoken: The yellow box lists the three steps to sign up. Here's how each one looks.
segments.tts: The yellow box lists the three steps to sign up. Here's how each one looks.

segments.spoken: Every date gets its own card. A grey card with a lock means someone already has that day.
segments.tts: Every date gets its own card. A grey card with a lock means someone already has that day.

segments.spoken: The card also shows the cleaner and the inspector for that day, so you know who you're working with.
segments.tts: The card also shows the cleaner and the inspector for that day, so you know who you're working with.

segments.spoken: A white card with an empty box is open for you. The word Needed means that job is still available.
segments.tts: A white card with an empty box is open for you. The word Needed means that job is still available.

segments.spoken: Each card gives you the date, the hours, and who else is working that day.
segments.tts: Each card gives you the date, the hours, and who else is working that day.

segments.spoken: Some cards say same-day turnover, right next to the hours.
segments.tts: Some cards say same-day turnover, right next to the hours.

segments.spoken: And some cards show only the checkout time, like this one.
segments.tts: And some cards show only the checkout time, like this one.

segments.spoken: The dates run in order, soonest first. Keep scrolling to see the months ahead.
segments.tts: The dates run in order, soonest first. Keep scrolling to see the months ahead.

segments.spoken: Found a day you like? Tap the card. The box fills in with a check mark.
segments.tts: [happy] Found a day you like? Tap the card. The box fills in with a check mark.

segments.spoken: Pick as many dates as you want, all in one visit.
segments.tts: Pick as many dates as you want, all in one visit.

segments.spoken: Now the important part: tap Sign me up. That tap puts your name on the La Maison calendar.
segments.tts: [warmly] Now the important part: tap Sign me up. That tap puts your name on the La Maison calendar.

segments.spoken: A check mark alone doesn't save your spot. If you leave without tapping Sign me up, the date stays open.
segments.tts: A check mark alone doesn't save your spot. If you leave without tapping Sign me up, the date stays open.

segments.spoken: The Sign me up button waits at the bottom of the screen. It turns dark blue once you've changed a date.
segments.tts: The Sign me up button waits at the bottom of the screen. It turns dark blue once you've changed a date.

segments.spoken: Once you're signed up, your name shows on that day's calendar event, from checkout to check-in.
segments.tts: Once you're signed up, your name shows on that day's calendar event, from checkout to check-in.

segments.spoken: You'll also see a calendar with all of your dates on it.
segments.tts: You'll also see a calendar with all of your dates on it.

segments.spoken: Plans change, and that's fine. Uncheck the date, tap Sign me up again, and it opens up for someone else.
segments.tts: [warmly] Plans change, and that's fine. Uncheck the date, tap Sign me up again, and it opens up for someone else.

segments.spoken: Inspectors, your link works the same way, with inspections in place of cleanings.
segments.tts: Inspectors, your link works the same way, with inspections in place of cleanings.

segments.spoken: Your white cards are the dates that still need an inspection. You can also see who's cleaning that day.
segments.tts: Your white cards are the dates that still need an inspection. You can also see who's cleaning that day.

segments.spoken: Cleaners and inspectors sign up separately, so one date can have both of you on it.
segments.tts: Cleaners and inspectors sign up separately, so one date can have both of you on it.

segments.spoken: Next up, the Tasks tab. Inspectors, this is your checklist for every visit.
segments.tts: [happy] Next up, the Tasks tab. Inspectors, this is your checklist for every visit.

segments.spoken: The welcome box sums it up: open each area of the house, check off every item, then tap Submit.
segments.tts: The welcome box sums it up: open each area of the house, check off every item, then tap Submit.

segments.spoken: Please go through the whole list every time, even if the house looked great last visit.
segments.tts: [warmly] Please go through the whole list every time, even if the house looked great last visit.

segments.spoken: There are 76 items, sorted into 13 areas like Bathroom, Kitchen, and Living Areas.
segments.tts: There are 76 items, sorted into 13 areas like Bathroom, Kitchen, and Living Areas.

segments.spoken: Tap an area to open it. The numbers on the right keep track of how far you've gotten.
segments.tts: Tap an area to open it. The numbers on the right keep track of how far you've gotten.

segments.spoken: Each item is one small thing to check, like placing toilet paper in the cabinets over the toilets.
segments.tts: Each item is one small thing to check, like placing toilet paper in the cabinets over the toilets.

segments.spoken: Finished an item? Tap the box next to it.
segments.tts: Finished an item? Tap the box next to it.

segments.spoken: Curious why an item is on the list? Tap Instructions and why it matters for the reason behind it.
segments.tts: [curious] Curious why an item is on the list? Tap Instructions and why it matters for the reason behind it.

segments.spoken: Finished items get a check mark and a line through them, and your count goes up.
segments.tts: [happy] Finished items get a check mark and a line through them, and your count goes up.

segments.spoken: Tapped one by mistake? Tap it again to uncheck it.
segments.tts: Tapped one by mistake? Tap it again to uncheck it.

segments.spoken: Then move on to the next area. The Kitchen has 10 items, from the coffee to the pots and pans.
segments.tts: Then move on to the next area. The Kitchen has 10 items, from the coffee to the pots and pans.

segments.spoken: At the bottom, you can see how many items you've completed.
segments.tts: At the bottom, you can see how many items you've completed.

segments.spoken: All done? Tap Submit inspection, and your results are on their way to us.
segments.tts: [happy] All done? Tap Submit inspection, and your results are on their way to us.

segments.spoken: If you see a Your name box above the button, type your name first.
segments.tts: If you see a Your name box above the button, type your name first.

segments.spoken: Running low on something at the house? That's what the Supplies tab is for.
segments.tts: [curious] Running low on something at the house? That's what the Supplies tab is for.

segments.spoken: It's three steps again: pick the item, say how much is left, and tap Add Item to List.
segments.tts: [warmly] It's three steps again: pick the item, say how much is left, and tap Add Item to List.

segments.spoken: Tap the first box to open the list of items the house uses.
segments.tts: Tap the first box to open the list of items the house uses.

segments.spoken: Or start typing. Type paper, and you'll see paper towels and toilet paper.
segments.tts: Or start typing. Type paper, and you'll see paper towels and toilet paper.

segments.spoken: Can't find it? You can add what you typed as a new item.
segments.tts: Can't find it? You can add what you typed as a new item.

segments.spoken: Then say how much is left, like 2 rolls or half a bottle.
segments.tts: Then say how much is left, like 2 rolls or half a bottle.

segments.spoken: Tap Add Item to List, and we'll restock it.
segments.tts: [happy] Tap Add Item to List, and we'll restock it.

segments.spoken: Need the pool service or a plumber? The Contractors tab has La Maison's maintenance vendors.
segments.tts: [curious] Need the pool service or a plumber? The Contractors tab has La Maison's maintenance vendors.

segments.spoken: Find the contractor you need, then tap to text or email them.
segments.tts: [warmly] Find the contractor you need, then tap to text or email them.

segments.spoken: The search box finds a vendor by name, type, phone, or email.
segments.tts: The search box finds a vendor by name, type, phone, or email.

segments.spoken: Type pool, for example, and the pool service comes right up.
segments.tts: Type pool, for example, and the pool service comes right up.

segments.spoken: Tap Text or Email to reach them directly.
segments.tts: Tap Text or Email to reach them directly.

segments.spoken: If a vendor has no email on file, the Email button is faded, so send a text.
segments.tts: If a vendor has no email on file, the Email button is faded, so send a text.

segments.spoken: And if you ever forget a step, the Help tab has it all in writing.
segments.tts: [happy] And if you ever forget a step, the Help tab has it all in writing.

segments.spoken: It covers the whole visit: pick your dates, get on the calendar, then use Tasks, Supplies, and Contractors on the day.
segments.tts: It covers the whole visit: pick your dates, get on the calendar, then use Tasks, Supplies, and Contractors on the day.

segments.spoken: That's everything. Thank you for taking such good care of La Maison.
segments.tts: [warmly] That's everything. Thank you for taking such good care of La Maison.
